title: Standby Confidence Index + Failover Sequencer (SCI Sequencer)
creator: Priya Kapoor
description:
Background: We need a deterministic, observable, and auditable controller that decides multi-region cutovers and tier-based routing during regional capacity or performance incidents. Current warm-standby tooling provides health checks and simple priming, but lacks a unified readiness score and a sequenced decision engine that factors tier routing and compatible fallback model variants. This ticket defines the Standby Confidence Index (SCI) and implements a Failover Sequencer (the SCI Sequencer) which will be the canonical gate for automatic and assisted cross-region failovers.

Goals:
- Define an SCI metric that aggregates cache warmth, KV cache hit rate, model artifact readiness, GPU memory residency, priming latency, and probe pass rates into a single 0.0-1.0 score by region/tier/model-variant.
- Implement a sequencer that uses SCI + policy rules to select target region and tier, apply fallback model variants if necessary, and execute a phased cutover (canary -> ramp -> full) with automated rollback.
- Surface SCI and decision rationale in the Console and operator logs for auditability.
- Ensure the sequencer integrates with existing routing and capacity components and respects reserved Dedicated pools and customer routing preferences.

Scope (this ticket):
- Metric definition, scoring weights, thresholds per tier (premium/standard/burst).
- Readiness probes and prefill tasks that contribute to SCI (prefetch KV, model warm loads, synthetic token priming).
- Sequencer logic and APIs to request a candidate region/tier, evaluate SCI and alternative model variants, and emit a decision with rationale.
- Console exposure (SCI timeline and failover rationale) and basic telemetry events.
- Integration tests (chaos and blackhole simulations) and runbook updates.

Out of scope: automated infra provisioning for new regions, deep KMS onboarding, per-customer custom policies (handled later).
acceptance_criteria:
1) SCI computed every 60s for each region-tier-model_variant tuple and stored in time-series (metrics with tags).
2) SCI exposed in Console per-region with a historical timeline and a current numeric value.
3) Failover Sequencer can perform a simulated automated cutover in staging when in-region qps drops by >30% and target region/tier SCI >= 0.85.
4) When primary model variant is not available, sequencer will select a compatible fallback variant per mapping and document the delta in decision rationale.
5) Unit/integration tests for sequencing logic (canary -> ramp -> full) pass in CI and chaos test simulating node eviction completes without data corruption.
6) On-call runbook updated with explicit abort and rollback steps and at least one dry-run documented with timestamps and outcome.
